claim: Text pipeline: TokenizationManager strips non-[a-zA-Z0-9] and lowercases (English-only), HuggingFaceTokenizer loads tokenizer.json/tokenizer_config.json/special_tokens_map.json from res/raw, emits inputIds/attentionMask/tokenTypeIds of fixed length 512; TextClassificationEngine feeds 3 long[1][seqLen] tensors (input_ids/token_type_ids/attention_mask) and applies plain softmax.
observed_fact: Read all three in full: preprocessText regex [^a-zA-Z0-9\s] -> lowercase ROOT; HuggingFaceTokenizer loads 3 JSON raws, simpleTokenize splits on whitespace with vocab/[UNK] fallback and cls/sep tokens; tokenize pads/truncates to maxLength=512 (MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH); TextClassificationEngine.classifyText builds 3 OnnxTensors, maps by input name with input_ids fallback, extractRawOutput handles float[]/Object[], softMax normalizes; ScoreResults carries inferenceTimeMs.

claim: OTPClassifier scores short-code SMS as Spam/Legit with a 49KB ONNX model (mfaondevice_1_1234567890.onnx) over a TF-IDF vector (sklearn-style config in tfidf_config.json); SPAM_THRESHOLD=0.5.

claim: AnalysisManager orchestrates on-device analysis: isShortCode heuristic (non-contact, inbound, Bark Phone only; 3-6 digit or letter-bearing numbers) gates OTPClassifier; formats versioned score JSONs {adult_explicit:{present,score,version,deleted}} and {non_otp_unknown_sms:{abusive,score,version,deleted}} stored in MessagesDB.scores.
observed_fact: Read in full: isShortCode rejects empty number/message, non-Bark-Phone, sent messages, numbers in contacts; accepts letter-bearing numbers, 3-6 digit numbers, 7-digit starting with 1, 8-digit; analyzeShortCode runs OTPClassifier and writes barkMessage.scores; formatImageAnalysisScores/formatShortCodeAnalysisScores embed model version via getModelVersion() (raw resource entry name); deletion flags from isMediaDeletionEnabled (SDK>=30 + MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE + explicit monitoring) and isScamDeletionEnabled.
